title: Ambience
description: A recording (rain, a room tone, a crowd) turned into a seamless ambience of any length: stretches of it are chained with crossfades, from random places, so no loop can be heard.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.doc: Off passes the sound through untouched (bypass).

parameters.name: file
parameters.placeholder: choose a recording of the project

parameters.name: start
parameters.doc: Where in the recording the useful part starts, in seconds (empty: the beginning).

parameters.name: end
parameters.doc: Where the useful part ends, in seconds (empty: the end).

parameters.name: segment
parameters.doc: Average length of one stretch before the next one is faded in.

parameters.name: crossfade
parameters.doc: Length of the crossfade between stretches.

parameters.name: variation
parameters.doc: How much the stretch length varies.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).

needs: A recording (WAV) of the project to build the ambience from (parameter file).
